svg.text: What comparable laws took: months from proposal to the Official Journal
The 22 adopted acts we follow, one dot each; data of 24 November 2026.
Filled dot: adopted away from an election; hollow dot: crossed Parliament's election break; line: median of all files with trilogues.

circle.data-tip: Digital Omnibus on AI: 8 months (Nov 2025 to Jul 2026)
Reg. 2022/2480: 10 months (Feb 2022 to Dec 2022)
Digital Decade Policy Programme 2030: 15 months (Sep 2021 to Dec 2022)
Net Zero Industry Act: 16 months (Mar 2023 to Jun 2024); crossed the election break
Market Surveillance Regulation: 18 months (Dec 2017 to Jun 2019); crossed the election break
Cybersecurity Act: 21 months (Sep 2017 to Jun 2019); crossed the election break
CSA amendment 2025/37: 21 months (Apr 2023 to Jan 2025); crossed the election break
Cyber Solidarity Act: 21 months (Apr 2023 to Jan 2025); crossed the election break
General Product Safety Regulation: 23 months (Jun 2021 to May 2023)
NIS 2 Directive: 24 months (Dec 2020 to Dec 2022)
Internal Market Emergency and Resilience Act: 26 months (Sep 2022 to Nov 2024); crossed the election break
IMERA directive: 26 months (Sep 2022 to Nov 2024); crossed the election break
IMERA omnibus: 26 months (Sep 2022 to Nov 2024); crossed the election break
Product Liability Directive: 26 months (Sep 2022 to Nov 2024); crossed the election break
Cyber Resilience Act: 26 months (Sep 2022 to Nov 2024); crossed the election break
Machinery Regulation: 26 months (Apr 2021 to Jun 2023)
Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation: 27 months (Mar 2022 to Jun 2024); crossed the election break
Toy Safety Regulation: 28 months (Jul 2023 to Dec 2025); crossed the election break
DSM Copyright Directive: 32 months (Sep 2016 to May 2019); crossed the election break
ECCC Regulation: 33 months (Sep 2018 to Jun 2021); crossed the election break
European Health Data Space Regulation: 34 months (May 2022 to Mar 2025); crossed the election break
AI Act: 39 months (Apr 2021 to Jul 2024); crossed the election break

svg.text: Source: EP Legislative Observatory, COD files with trilogues since 2012 and the acts we follow.
